bar_text: RandomForest (default), at 1,000 Elo, is the bar for resubmitting to TabArena: 1,000 overall Elo (design review DR7.6, owner decision 2026-11-13).
entry_text: It is not the zero-shot model. A logistic regression (ridge for regression) is fitted on the network's representation of each training split, one per partition leaf for classification; for multiclass and regression it also takes the row's own features. Binary runs on the published checkpoint, multiclass and regression on unpublished checkpoints. These are general-tabular results, not credit results: on real credit panels FinTFM currently loses to gradient boosting (FINDINGS §216).
types_note: Each figure comes from a leaderboard over that problem type's datasets only, so the four are not on one scale with each other or with the headline.
